runs.title: Jepchirchir: the substance and what the AIU said
runs.prompt: On 23 October 2026 it was reported that Olympic and world marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir has been provisionally suspended. Using only page fetches, find out: which banned substance was found in her sample, and what the Athletics Integrity Unit has said about the case. runs.answer: The Athletics Integrity Unit announced on 23 October 2026 that world and Olympic marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir (Kenya) has been provisionally suspended after an out-of-competition sample collected in Kenya returned an adverse analytical finding for EPO (erythropoietin), the banned blood booster that increases red blood cell production. The AIU said the sample was taken before her Sydney Marathon victory in August 2026, where she ran 2:18:31. Her agent Gianni Demadonna said he felt "terrible" and that athletes using performance-enhancing drugs should be disqualified, while Sydney Marathon organisers said they were "extremely disappointed" but that Jepchirchir is "entitled to due process."
